author: Sophia
title: The ex -wife of singer Grigory Leps said that she had left her daughter from Russia
text:
The ex -wife of singer Grigory Leps said that she flew with her daughter from Russia. Anna Shamplykova published photos from Japan on social networks, in which she not only expressed herself, but also the 23 -year -old heir.
After parting with artists, Anna continued to enjoy trips and spend a lot of time with children. Not long ago, she decided to fly to Japan to admire nature. The woman took her daughter through the journey.
On the new frames, the mother and daughter posed on the forest and Sakura has flowers. Anna refused makeup and had no designs. Eve removed her hair and also appeared in a natural form.
Recalling that Leps broke up with his ex -wife in 2021. They were together for 20 years and gave birth to three children. In addition to Eve, they also have a 17 -year -old daughter Nicole and 14 -year -old son Ivan. The singer did not hide that only him blamed the divorce. The man admitted that in the “ugly form”, he insulted the woman. Even so, they still keep in touch for the benefit of the heirs.
Now Gregory is happy in relationship with Bride Aurora Kibu, who is only 19 years old. They publicly discussed the wedding, but did not call the exact date. We wrote earlier than they wrote the fact that the girl flew out of Russia. She returned to London to continue studying.
